To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
screen reader users rely on a combination of factors when assessing credibility of web pages.
the title of the result, the snippet, and the content of the result all play a significant role in credibility assessment.

blind screen reader users are more likely to determine whether sites are credible by assessing the title of search results and their corresponding snippets, and the richness of the content once a search result has been selected.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the factors that blind users consider when evaluating credibility of web sites and search results.
understanding how screen reader users assess credibility of web-based content.
the development of an accessible web search engine that will allow blind screen reader users to determine credibility of web sites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
screen reader users have difficulty in determining credibility of web pages.
screen reader users are able to determine the credibility of a web page, but this is not an easy task.
the credibility assessment process of blind users is based on a number of different cues.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
blind screen reader users have a strong desire to assess the credibility of web-based information.
the credibility assessment of web sites and their content is a multi-faceted task.
the title of the web page and the content of the search snippet can be used to assess the credibility of a web site.
The main takeaway from our work is that
screen reader users are able to assess credibility in a similar way as their sighted peers, but with the additional consideration of accessibility.
blind users can be assisted in the credibility assessment process, and that the design of web-based search engines should be informed by the findings of our work.
blind screen reader users have a number of strategies for assessing credibility.
